meta.title: Ocean D'souza — Platform Product Manager Launch Video

scenes.purpose: Establish personal brand authority and role immediately within 3 seconds
scenes.layout: Split view: left side prominent kinetic headline and status badge, right side framed portrait in ambient radial glow
scenes.elements: Emerald status beacon, Ocean D'souza name in display typography, role tag, and portrait card
scenes.animation: Name springs from translateY(24) with opacity 0->1 and blur 8->0 over 0.5s; portrait scales from 0.94->1.0 with subtle perspective tilt
scenes.lighting: Emerald ambient glow from top-left, subtle specular rim light on portrait edge
scenes.transitionOut: Directional slide-left with motion blur into Scene 2

scenes.purpose: Demonstrate tangible platform scale and shipped impact
scenes.layout: Grid of 4 high-contrast glassmorphic platform cards with metrics and partner badges
scenes.elements: BarakatFresh (+24% ATC), Checkout.com (+18% Conv), BEXA AI (5,000+ SKUs), Dynamics 365 (-85% Effort)
scenes.animation: Cards cascade in with 90ms stagger, numbers count up, glowing emerald accent lines pulse across top borders
scenes.camera: Pan across cards with slight 3D rotation (Y-axis 4deg -> 0deg)
scenes.lighting: Volumetric light sweep across card surfaces at 1.2s
scenes.transitionOut: Converge inward to center focal point

scenes.purpose: Memorable branding, live production URL and direct contact call-to-action
scenes.emotionalBeat: Resolution, polished finish, immediate desire to visit and connect
scenes.layout: Centered hero OD monogram emblem with pulsing status rings, production domain pill, and contact CTAs
scenes.elements: OD Monogram, ocean-dsouza-portfolio.vercel.app, Topmate & Email badges
scenes.animation: Emblem slams into center with elastic spring overshoot, expanding emerald shockwave ring, domain pill unfolds
scenes.lighting: Centered spotlight vignette with floating particle shimmer
scenes.transitionOut: Hold until fade to black at frame 295
